post.text:
Trump just got owned.

Trump to Spain: “We’ll remove you from NATO and suspend all trade agreements.”

President Sánchez: “Do whatever you want, just stay away from us.” https://t.co/VMIw39qB5R
post.author_description: Strategy, reputation and action as a day job. Also proud Trustee @ESBUK. @avfcofficial fan. Views my own.

description.description: A group of men in suits walking in an official-looking room. Pedro Sánchez, the Prime Minister of Spain, is in the center with António Costa, the Prime Minister of Portugal, walking to his left. Several other men follow behind them, including a man in a military-style uniform.
